user_review.comment: Junior Suite is a room for 3pax but we booked it nonetheless for both of us for ann unblocked paddy field view. We booked the room 3 months ahead. Upon arrival, owner told us he ‘upgraded’ us to Family Room with obstructed views of paddy fields. We requested for the room we booked but was told it was taken. No apologies. No refund. No compensation. With the overgrown trees, there is only one room with unblocked paddy field views. We visited the neighbourhood cafes and restaurants to enjoy the paddy field relaxing vibes instead.

Total scam. Even the name...not the real Four Seasons and no villa. Had to walk up 4 flights of stairs to get to a tiny room like a motel 6. No dining room. Pictures must be of some other property. Don't fall for this scam of a property!
